submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile (FeSbO4-type) phase at every tested point, index 0 through 28. Sb-rich films (index 21 and 28) also show an extra Sb-oxide peak near Q≈2.47. EQE rose steadily toward the Fe-rich end: 0.018% at index 13 (Fe0.51), 0.110% at index 4 (Fe0.76) and 0.228% at index 1 (Fe0.86). Index 1 is the best measured composition.

rejected.reason: Sb-rich, has a secondary Sb-oxide phase, and falls on the low-EQE side of the trend (not measured)
